name: Marie Badoux — daughter Claudine Thénot (b. 1781, Romenay)
researcher_question: Was Claudine Thénot, baptised 12 October 1781 at Romenay to Philippe Thénot and Marie Joly, a daughter of Marie Badoux — or of a second wife?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 11, hint-samples.csv row 377, flag adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-09-17: false match, no substitute found. Decisive evidence is Marie Badoux's burial 22 Mar 1780 recording death 21 Mar 1780 (ark:/61903/1:1:W5XV-6XPZ), nineteen months before the hinted 12 Oct 1781 baptism (ark:/61903/1:1:W5XL-MP3Z), which independently names the mother as Marie Joly. Encoded as an avoid guard plus a negative-conclusion finding, both required:true. apply_avoid_guard is relationship-blind and so force-fails f1 on a run that re-attaches Claudine to her actual parents, which is why the committed run reads partial; a run that simply declines the hint reports pass (issue #2640) -- see the README's Encoding note. Second opinion: Richard Chesworth.
